text: Ma mi faloɓe gaay e laawol focciingol ngol, ma mi yelinyɓe yela fenaande ko no cuɗinana ɓe majjere nden, ma mi yamiroyɓe taygol noppi neemoraaɗi ɗin fii harmingol ko Alla Dagini kon e majji, ma mi yamiroyɓe waylugol tagu Alla ngun". Kala on jogitorɗo seytaane giɗo, gomɗii haray on ɗon sooyii sooyannde ɓanngunde.
